name: Action Request
definition: A request is the act or instance of asking for something, such as a request for information, bid submission, or performance of work.

name: Email
definition: Request was made through email.

name: Fax
definition: Request was made through facsimile.

name: Phone
definition: Request was made verbally over a telephone.

name: Post
definition: Request was made through postal mail.

name: Verbal
definition: Request was made verbally in person.

name: Actor
definition: The [[IfcActor]] defines all actors or human agents involved in a project during its full life cycle. It facilitates the use of person and organization definitions in the resource part of the IFC object model. This includes name, address, telecommunication addresses, and roles.

name: Actuator
definition: An actuator is a mechanical device for moving or controlling a mechanism or system. An actuator takes energy, usually created by air, electricity, or liquid, and converts that into some kind of motion.

name: Electric Actuator
definition: A device that electrically actuates a control element.

name: Hand Operated Actuator
definition: A device that manually actuates a control element.

name: Hydraulic Actuator
definition: A device that hydraulically actuates a control element.

name: Pneumatic Actuator
definition: A device that pneumatically actuates a control element.

name: Thermostatic Actuator
definition: A device that thermostatically actuates a control element.

name: Air Terminal
definition: An air terminal is a terminating or origination point for the transfer of air between distribution system(s) and one or more spaces. It can also be used for the transfer of air between adjacent spaces.

name: Air Terminal Box
definition: An air terminal box typically participates in an HVAC duct distribution system and is used to control or modulate the amount of air delivered to its downstream ductwork. An air terminal box type is often referred to as an 'air flow regulator'.

name: Constant Flow
definition: Terminal box does not include a means to reset the volume automatically to an outside signal such as thermostat.

name: Variable Flow Pressure Dependant
definition: air-flow rate depends on supply pressure.

name: Variable Flow Pressure Independant
definition: air-flow rate is independent of supply pressure.

name: Diffuser
definition: An outlet discharging supply air in various directions and planes.

name: Grille
definition: A covering for any area through which air passes.

name: Louvre
definition: A rectilinear louvre.

name: Register
definition: A grille typically equipped with a damper or control valve.

name: Air to Air Heat Recovery
definition: An air-to-air heat recovery device employs a counter-flow heat exchanger between inbound and outbound air flow. It is typically used to transfer heat from warmer air in one chamber to cooler air in the second chamber (i.e., typically used to recover heat from the conditioned air being exhausted and the outside air being supplied to a building), resulting in energy savings from reduced heating (or cooling) requirements.

name: Fixed Plate Counter Flow Exchanger
definition: [[Heat]] exchanger with moving parts and alternate layers of plates, separated and sealed from the exhaust and supply air stream passages with primary air entering at secondary air outlet location and exiting at secondary air inlet location.

name: Fixed Plate Cross Flow Exchanger
definition: [[Heat]] exchanger with moving parts and alternate layers of plates, separated and sealed from the exhaust and supply air stream passages with secondary air flow in the direction perpendicular to primary air flow.

name: Fixed Plate Parallel Flow Exchanger
definition: [[Heat]] exchanger with moving parts and alternate layers of plates, separated and sealed from the exhaust and supply air stream passages with primary air entering at secondary air inlet location and exiting at secondary air outlet location.

name: Heat Pipe
definition: A passive energy recovery device with a heat pipe divided into evaporator and condenser sections.

name: Rotary Wheel
definition: A heat wheel with a revolving cylinder filled with an air-permeable medium having a large internal surface area.

name: Runaround Coil Loop
definition: A typical coil energy recovery loop places extended surface, finned tube water coils in the supply and exhaust airstreams of a building.

name: Thermo Siphon Coil Type Heat Exchangers
definition: Sealed systems that consist of an evaporator, a condenser, interconnecting piping, and an intermediate working fluid that is present in both liquid and vapor phases where the evaporator and condensor coils are installed independently in the ducts and are interconnected by the working fluid piping.

name: Thermo Siphon Sealed Tube Heat Exchangers
definition: Sealed systems that consist of an evaporator, a condenser, interconnecting piping, and an intermediate working fluid that is present in both liquid and vapor phases where the evaporator and the condenser are usually at opposite ends of a bundle of straight, individual thermosiphon tubes and the exhaust and supply ducts are adjacent to each other.

name: Twin Tower Enthalpy Recovery Loops
definition: An air-to-liquid, liquid-to-air enthalpy recovery system with a sorbent liquid circulates continuously between supply and exhaust airstreams, alternately contacting both airstreams directly in contactor towers.

name: Alarm
definition: An alarm is a device that signals the existence of a condition or situation that is outside the boundaries of normal expectation or that activates such a device.

name: Bell
definition: An audible alarm.

name: Break Glass Button
definition: An alarm activation mechanism in which a protective glass has to be broken to enable a button to be pressed.

name: Light
definition: A visual alarm.

name: Manual Pull Box
definition: An alarm activation mechanism in which activation is achieved by a pulling action.

name: Railway Crocodile
definition: An electrical contact placed between the rails (in the four-foot way) to provide warnings in the locomotive cab.

name: Railway Detonator
definition: A coin-sized device that is used as a loud warning signal to train drivers. It is usually placed on the top of the rail, usually secured with two lead straps, one on each side.

name: Siren
definition: An audible alarm.

name: Whistle
definition: An audible alarm.

name: Alignment
definition: For the purposes of IFC the English term 'alignment' defines three separate but closely interconnected concepts.

name: Annotation
definition: An annotation is an information element within the geometric (and spatial) context of a project, that adds a note or meaning to the objects which constitutes the project model. Annotations include additional points, curves, text, dimensioning, hatching and other forms of graphical notes. It also includes virtual or symbolic representations of additional model components, not representing products or spatial structures, such as survey points and lines, contour lines or similar.

name: Contourline
definition: Annotation used to illustrate lines connecting points of equal elevation or depth, on a map or chart.

name: Dimension
definition: Annotation used to illustrate the measurement or size of an object, often accompanied by numerical values.

name: Isobar
definition: Annotation used to illustrate lines connecting points of equal pressure on a map or chart.

name: Isolux
definition: Annotation used to illustrate lines connecting points of equal illuminance or light intensity.

name: Isotherm
definition: Annotation used to illustrate lines connecting points of equal temperature on a map or chart.

name: Leader
definition: Annotation that includes a line or arrow.

name: Survey
definition: Annotation used for survey information, such as survey points, survey lines or survey areas.

name: Symbol
definition: Annotation that employs graphical symbols or icons to represent specific meanings.

name: Text
definition: A textual annotation.

name: Asset
definition: An asset is a uniquely identifiable grouping of elements acting as a single entity that has a financial value or that can be operated on as a single unit.

name: Audio Visual Appliance
definition: An audio-visual appliance is a device that displays, captures, transmits, or receives audio or video.

name: Amplifier
definition: A device that receives an audio signal and amplifies it to play through speakers.

name: Camera
definition: A device that records images, either as a still photograph or as moving images known as videos or movies. Note that a camera may operate with light from the visible spectrum or from other parts of the electromagnetic spectrum such as infrared or ultraviolet.

name: Communication Terminal
definition: A communication terminal is an audio communication device that is usually installed along transportation infrastructure (railways, roads, tunnels etc.) in order to be used by the general public or operation agents for communication. It may specifically be used to make calls to emergency services in tunnels.

name: Display
definition: An electronic device that represents information in visual form such as a flat-panel display or television.

name: Microphone
definition: An acoustic-to-electric transducer or sensor that converts sound into an electrical signal. Microphones types in use include electromagnetic induction (dynamic microphones), capacitance change (condenser microphones) or piezoelectric generation to produce the signal from mechanical vibration.

name: P Layer
definition: A device that plays audio and/or video content directly or to another device, having fixed or removable storage media.

name: Projector
definition: An apparatus for projecting a picture on a screen. Whether the device is an overhead, slide projector, or a film projector, it is usually referred to as simply a projector.

name: Receiver
definition: A device that receives audio and/or video signals, switches sources, and amplifies signals to play through speakers.

name: Recording Equipment
definition: A recording equipment is a device that records telephone calls or other types of audio data. It also provides the function of archiving and immediate replay.

name: Speaker
definition: A loudspeaker, speaker, or speaker system is an electroacoustical transducer that converts an electrical signal to sound.

name: Switcher
definition: A device that receives audio and/or video signals, switches sources, and transmits signals to downstream devices.

name: Telephone
definition: A telecommunications device that is used to transmit and receive sound, and optionally video.

name: Tuner
definition: An electronic receiver that detects, demodulates, and amplifies transmitted signals.

name: Beam
definition: An [[IfcBeam]] is typically a horizontal, or nearly horizontal, structural member that is capable of withstanding load primarily by resisting bending. It may also represent such a member from an architectural point of view. It is not required to be load bearing.

name: Beam
definition: A standard beam usually used horizontally.

name: Cornice
definition: A non-loadbearing beam on the longitudinal edge of bridge slab, usually encasing installations.

name: Diaphragm
definition: End portion of a girder transmitting loads to supports and providing moment resistance to adjoining segment.

name: Edgebeam
definition: A beam on the longitudinal edge of bridge slab, usually concrete, providing additional stiffening and protection from the elements.

name: Girder Segment
definition: A segment of a girder (e.g. each span of a continuous girder).

name: Hatstone
definition: A beam on top of a retaining wall or a wing wall, preventing earth movement.

name: Hollow Core
definition: A wide often prestressed beam with a hollow-core profile that usually serves as a slab component.

name: Joist
definition: A beam used to support a floor or ceiling.

name: Lintel
definition: A beam or horizontal piece of material over an opening (e.g. door, window).

name: Pier Cap
definition: A transversal beam on top of a pier (on a single column or extending from one column of a pier to another column of the same pier).

name: Spandrel
definition: A tall beam placed on the facade of a building. One tall side is usually finished to provide the exterior of the building. Can be used to support joists or slab elements on its interior side.

name: T Beam
definition: A beam that forms part of a slab construction and acts together with the slab which it carries. Such beams are often of T-shape (therefore the English name), but may have other shapes as well, e.g. an L-Shape or an Inverted-T-Shape.

name: Bearing
definition: [[Type]] of building element that is usually used to transmit loads from superstructure to substructure, and usually allowing movement (displacement or rotation) in one or more degrees of freedom. It is typically a mechanical component procured as a whole and installed on site, but in simple cases it may be built on site (composed of other building elements, element components, etc.).

name: Cylindrical
definition: The bearing functionality is provided by cylinder in a concave cylinder.

name: Disk
definition: A disk bearing consist of an elastomeric disc between two metal plates.

name: Elastomeric
definition: A pad bearing which carries vertical load by contact stresses between a sheet of sliding material and a mating surface that permits movements by sliding and accommodates rotation by deformation of the elastomer.

name: Guide
definition: A bearing that ensures that the structure maintains the correct location or expansion/contraction path and takes no vertical load. Includes also restraint bearings.

name: Pot
definition: A bearing which carries vertical load by compression of an (elastomeric) disc confined in a (steel) cylinder and which accommodates rotations by deformations of the disc.

name: Rocker
definition: The bearing functionality is provided by a rocker construction. Includes line rocker and point rocker bearings.

name: Roller
definition: The bearing functionality is provided by one or more rollers that are placed between two plates.

name: Spherical
definition: The bearing functionality is provided by convex dome in a concave basin.

name: Boiler
definition: A boiler is a closed, pressure-rated vessel in which water or other fluid is heated using an energy source such as natural gas, heating oil, or electricity. The fluid in the vessel is then circulated out of the boiler for use in various processes or heating applications.

name: Steam
definition: [[Steam]] boiler.

name: Water
definition: [[Water]] boiler.

name: Borehole
definition: Representation of the concept of a linear geological and geotechnical model, usually an interpretation but sometimes created direct from ground penetrating measurement; The assembly may contain one of more strata and other elements such as capping and lining. The contained subtypes of [[IfcGeotechnicalStratum]] will have shape representations made from straight or bent tubes reflecting the bore diameter, or discs if a 'Yabuki' top surface model is being used.

name: Bridge
definition: A Bridge is a civil engineering work that affords passage to pedestrians, animals, vehicles, and services above obstacles or between two points at a height above ground.

name: Arched
definition: Bridge that has one or more arches as its main structure.

name: Cable Stayed
definition: Bridge with one or more towers and inclined cables that are connected to the top or the shaft of the tower and support the deck.

name: Cantilever
definition: Bridge, the main structural members of which are cantilevers.

name: Culvert
definition: Transverse drain or waterway construction under a road, railway, or canal, or through an embankment, in the form of a large pipe or enclosed channel.

name: Framework
definition: Framework bridge.

name: Girder
definition: A bridge that uses girders as the means of supporting its deck.

name: Bridge Part
definition: Part of a bridge.

name: Abutment
definition: The substructures at the ends of a bridge, supporting its superstructure. They may be composed of wing walls (on each side), head wall, stem wall, and cone

name: Deck
definition: A bridge deck is comprised of those elements used for conveying traffic but does not perform structural functions of the superstructure

name: Deck Segment
definition: A segment of the bridge deck. Segments may be separated by construction or expansion joints

name: Foundation
definition: The structural elements that support and anchor the bridge to the ground, transmitting all loads to the supporting strata

name: Pier
definition: A bridge pier is a type of structure that extends to the ground below or into the water. It is used to support bridge superstructure and transfer the loads to the foundation.

name: Pier Segment
definition: A segment of the bridge pier. Segments may be separated by construction or expansion joints

name: Pylon
definition: A vertical structure supporting cables in suspended or stayed structures

name: Sub Structure
definition: The elements that transfer loads to the ground. It includes abutments and piers

name: Super Structure
definition: The part of the bridge that span horizontally and transfers the traffic load to the bridge substructures

name: Surface Structure
definition: Technical note: Because this class is a 'Predefined Type' in IFC, meaning a specialisation of its par

name: Suspension
definition: Bridge, the main structural members of which are catenary cables from which the deck is suspended.

name: Truss
definition: Bridge with braced triangulated frame designed to act as a beam.

name: Building
definition: A building represents a structure that provides shelter for its occupants or contents and stands in one place. The building is also used to provide a basic element within the spatial structure hierarchy for the components of a building project (together with site, storey, and space).

name: Building Element Part
definition: [[IfcBuildingElementPart]] represents major components as subordinate parts of a building element. Typical usage examples include precast concrete sandwich walls, where the layers may have different geometry representations. In this case the layered material representation does not sufficiently describe the element. Each layer is represented by an own instance of the [[IfcBuildingElementPart]] with its own geometry description.

name: Apron
definition: A form of scour protection consisting of timber, concrete, riprap, paving, or other construction placed adjacent to abutments and piers to prevent undermining.

name: Armour Unit
definition: A large quarry stone or concrete shaped unit used as erosion prevention on slopes such as revetments and breakwaters. These units are grouped together into a Course layer.

name: Insulation
definition: The part provides thermal insulation, for example as insulation layer between wall panels in sandwich walls or as infill in stud walls.

name: Precast Panel
definition: The part is a precast panel, usually as an internal or external layer in a sandwich wall panel.

name: Safety Cage
definition: Safety cages are an assembly of circular and vertical bars that are fastened to the stiles of fixed ladders and are arranged to enclose the path of a worker when climbing the ladder. Ladders so enclosed are also known as caged or hooped ladders.

name: Building Element Proxy
definition: The [[IfcBuildingElementProxy]] is a proxy definition that provides the same functionality as subtypes of [[IfcBuiltElement]], but without having a predefined meaning of the special type of building element it represents.

name: Building Storey
definition: The building storey has an elevation and typically represents a (nearly) horizontal aggregation of spaces that are vertically bound.

name: Built Element
definition: The built element comprises all elements that are primarily part of the construction of a built facility, i.e., its structural and space separating system. Built elements are all physically existent and tangible things.

name: Built System
definition: A built system is a group by which built elements are grouped according to a common function within the facility.

name: Erosion Prevention
definition: A grouping of elements into a built system for preventing unwanted relocation of material particles in earthworks slopes or rock faces.;Planting; Solid; Framework; Anchored framework; Shotcrete; Screening; Geosynthetics (geotextiles)

name: Fenestration
definition: [[System]] of doors, windows, and other fillings in openings in a built envelope that are designed to permit the passage of air or light.

name: Foundation
definition: [[System]] of shallow and deep foundation elements that transmit forces to the supporting ground.

name: Loadbearing
definition: [[System]] of built elements that transmit forces and stiffen the construction.

name: Mooring
definition: [[System]] of components and elements responsible for keeping or holding an element (a vessel, platform or set of catenary lines) in a desired position.

name: Outer Shell
definition: [[System]] of built elements that provide the outer skin to protect the construction (such as the facade).

name: Prestressing
definition: [[System]] of elements providing pre-stressing to the structure, including typically manufactured products such as tendons, anchorages (active, dead, coupling), ducts, vents and deviators, and in-situ concrete segments, tendon spacers, blisters and additional reinforcements.

name: Railway Line
definition: A set of functional tracks with explicit terminals. It is usually composed of a set of tracks with continuous track parts and alignments.

name: Railway Track
definition: Railway track system. It is usually composed of continuous sequences of track parts and alignments.

name: Reinforcing
definition: [[System]] of elements providing reinforcing to the structure.

name: Shading
definition: [[System]] of shading elements (external or internal) that permits the limitation or control of impact of natural sun light.

name: Track Circuit
definition: A track circuit is an electric circuit of which the rails of a track section form a part, with usually a source of current connected at one end and a detection device at the other end for detecting whether this track section is clear or occupied by a vehicle. In a continuous signalling system, the track circuit can be used to transmit information between the ground and the train.;definition from IEC 60050-82.

name: Transport
definition: [[System]] of all transport elements in a facility that enable the transport of people or goods.

name: Burner
definition: A burner is a device that converts fuel into heat through combustion. It includes gas, oil, and wood burners.

name: Cable Carrier Fitting
definition: A cable carrier fitting is a fitting that is placed at junction or transition in a cable carrier system.

name: Bend
definition: A fitting that changes the route of the cable carrier.

name: Connector
definition: Connector fitting, typically used to join two ports together within a flow distribution system (e.g., a coupling used to join two duct segments).

name: Cross
definition: A fitting at which two branches are taken from the main route of the cable carrier simultaneously.

name: Junction
definition: A fitting with typically more than two ports used to redistribute flow among the ports and/or to change the direction of flow between connected elements (e.g, tee, cross, wye, etc.).

name: Reducer
definition: A fitting that changes the physical size of the main route of the cable carrier.

name: Tee
definition: A fitting at which a branch is taken from the main route of the cable carrier.

name: Transition
definition: A fitting with typically two ports having different shapes or sizes. Can also be used to change the direction of flow between connected elements.

name: Cable Carrier Segment
definition: A cable carrier segment is a flow segment that is specifically used to carry and support cabling.

name: Cable Bracket
definition: A cable bracket is a horizontal cable support fixed at one end only, spaced at intervals, on which cables rest.

name: Cable Ladder Segment
definition: An open carrier segment on which cables are carried on a ladder structure.

name: Cable Tray Segment
definition: A (typically) open carrier segment onto which cables are laid.

name: Cable Trunking Segment
definition: An enclosed carrier segment with one or more compartments into which cables are placed.

name: Catenary Wire
definition: A catenary wire is a longitudinal wire supporting the grooved contact wires either directly or indirectly.;definition from UIC 719-1.

name: Conduit Segment
definition: An enclosed tubular carrier segment through which cables are pulled.

name: Dropper
definition: A dropper is a cable carrier used to suspend cable from another cable. It could also conduct electricity.

name: Cable Fitting
definition: A cable fitting is a fitting that is placed at a junction, transition or termination in a cable system.

name: Connector
definition: A fitting that joins two cable segments of the same connector type (though potentially different gender).

name: Entry
definition: A fitting that begins a cable segment at a non-electrical element such as a grounding clamp attached to a pipe.

name: Exit
definition: A fitting that ends a cable segment at a non-electrical element such as a grounding clamp attached to a pipe or to the ground.

name: Fanout
definition: A fan out is a special cable fitting that provides a safe transition from multi-fiber cable units to individual fibers.

name: Junction
definition: A fitting that joins three or more segments of arbitrary connector types for signal splitting or multiplexing.

name: Transition
definition: A fitting that joins two cable segments of different connector types.

name: Cable Segment
definition: A cable segment is a flow segment used to carry electrical power, data, or telecommunications signals.

name: Busbar Segment
definition: Electrical conductor that makes a common connection between several electrical circuits. Properties of a busbar are the same as those of a cable segment and are captured by the cable segment property set.

name: Cable Segment
definition: Cable with a specific purpose to lead electric current within a circuit or any other electric construction. Includes all types of electric cables, mainly several core segments or conductor segments wrapped together.

name: Conductors Egment
definition: A single linear element within a cable or an exposed wire (such as for grounding) with the specific purpose to lead electric current, data, or a telecommunications signal.

name: Contact Wire Segment
definition: An electric conductor of an overhead contact line with which the current collectors make contact.;definition from IEC60050 811-33-15.

name: Core Segment
definition: A self contained element of a cable that comprises one or more conductors and sheathing.The core of one lead is normally single wired or multiwired which are intertwined.

name: Fiber Segment
definition: A fiber segment is an individual optical fiber used in telecommunication systems to transmit data by means of optical signals.

name: Fiber Tube
definition: A fiber tube is semi-rigid hollow plastic tube with a very small radius that houses and protects a certain number of optical fiber segments. An optical cable segment may contain many fiber tubes.

name: Optical Cable Segment
definition: An optical cable segment is a cable segment that contains a variable number of optical fiber segments.

name: Stitch Wire
definition: A stitch wire consists of auxiliary wires and different components (clamp) used in stitched suspension.

name: Wi Repair Segment
definition: A pair of conductors contained in a copper cable. The pair is always used together to form a circuit to transmit data by means of electric signals.

name: Caisson Foundation
definition: CaissonFoundation essentially is a hollow box that can be either open or closed.

name: Caisson
definition: Closed box.

name: Well
definition: Open box.

name: Chiller
definition: A chiller is a device used to remove heat from a liquid via a vapor-compression or absorption refrigeration cycle to cool a fluid, typically water or a mixture of water and glycol. The chilled fluid is then used to cool and dehumidify air in a building.

name: Air Cooled
definition: Air cooled chiller.

name: Heat Recovery
definition: [[Heat]] recovery chiller.

name: Water Cooled
definition: [[Water]] cooled chiller.

name: Chimney
definition: Chimneys are typically vertical, or as near as vertical, parts of the construction of a building and part of the building fabric. Often constructed by pre-cast or insitu concrete, today seldom by bricks. Chimneys are used to evacuate flues from e.g. boilers or fire places.

name: Coil
definition: A coil is a device used to provide heat transfer between non-mixing media. A common example is a cooling coil, which utilizes a finned coil in which circulates chilled water, antifreeze, or refrigerant that is used to remove heat from air moving across the surface of the coil. A coil may be used either for heating or cooling purposes by placing a series of tubes (the coil) carrying a heating or cooling fluid into an airstream. The coil may be constructed from tubes bundled in a serpentine form or from finned tubes that give a extended heat transfer surface.

name: Dxcooling Coil
definition: Cooling coil using a refrigerant to cool the air stream directly.

name: Electric Heating Coil
definition: Heating coil using electricity as a heating source.

name: Gas Heating Coil
definition: Heating coil using gas as a heating source.

name: Hydronic Coil
definition: Cooling or Heating coil that uses a hydronic fluid as a cooling or heating source.

name: Steam Heating Coil
definition: Heating coil using steam as heating source.

name: Water Cooling Coil
definition: Cooling coil using chilled water. HYDRONICCOIL supercedes this enumerator.

name: Water Heating Coil
definition: Heating coil using hot water as a heating source. HYDRONICCOIL supercedes this enumerator.

name: Column
definition: An [[IfcColumn]] is a vertical structural or architectural member which often is aligned with a structural grid intersection. In most cases it represents a vertical, or nearly vertical, structural member that transmits, through compression, the weight of the structure above to other structural elements below. It may also represent such a member from an architectural point of view in which case it may represent a non load bearing element. Whether it is a structural load bearing element or a non-load bearing element is determined by the [[Pset_ColumnCommon]].[[LoadBearing]] property.

name: Column
definition: A usually vertical member that may be load bearing and requiring resistance to vertical forces by compression but also sometimes to lateral forces.

name: Pier Stem
definition: An individual vertical part of a pier, may be a simple column, i.e. no breakdown into segments or separate structural parts such as flanges and web(s), or may be an aggregation of segments and/or parts.

name: Pier Stem Segment
definition: A vertical segment of a pier column.

name: Pilaster
definition: A column element embedded within a wall that can be required to be load bearing but may also only be used for decorative purposes.

name: Stand Column
definition: A column transmitting vertical loads from a superstructure to an arch below it.

name: Communications Appliance
definition: A communications appliance transmits and receives electronic or digital information as data or sound.

name: Antenna
definition: A transducer designed to transmit or receive electromagnetic waves.

name: Automaton
definition: A self-acting artificial device, the behaviour of which is governed either in a stepwise manner by given decision rules or continuously in time by defined relationships, while the output variables of which are created from its input and state variables.;definition from IEC 60050-351-42-32.

name: Computer
definition: A desktop, laptop, tablet, or other type of computer that can be moved from one place to another and connected to an electrical supply via a plugged outlet.

name: Fax
definition: A machine that has the primary function of transmitting a facsimile copy of printed matter using a telephone line.

name: Gateway
definition: A gateway connects multiple network segments with different protocols at all layers (layers 1-7) of the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model.

name: Intelligent Peripheral
definition: An intelligent peripheral is a device that offers a variety of specialized resources according to the corresponding service logical program under the control of SCP. These resources contain the receiver of DTMF (Dual-Tone Multi-Frequency, signal generator, record notice, etc.). An intelligent peripheral provides dedicated resource functions in the intelligent network, allocates, controls and manages various dedicated resources, communicates with other entities in the network, and completes SRF resource functions as well as the maintenance, management and statistics functions of resources.

name: IP Network Equipment
definition: An IP network equipment is a device that provides IP data transmission channel for telecom subsystems or other subsystems e.g., routers, network switches or firewalls.

name: Line Side Electronic Unit
definition: The lineside electronic unit (LEU) is the interface between the balise and interlocking in railway. The LEU acquires the information from the interlocking, and sends the appropriate information to the balises in concordance with the lineside signalling (if available).

name: Modem
definition: A modem (from modulator-demodulator) is a device that modulates an analog carrier signal to encode digital information, and also demodulates such a carrier signal to decode the transmitted information.

name: Network Appliance
definition: A network appliance performs a dedicated function such as firewall protection, content filtering, load balancing, or equipment management.

name: Network Bridge
definition: A network bridge connects multiple network segments at the data link layer (layer 2) of the OSI model, and the term layer 2 switch is very often used interchangeably with bridge.

name: Network Hub
definition: A network hub connects multiple network segments at the physical layer (layer 1) of the OSI model.

name: Opticalline Terminal
definition: An optical line terminal is a service provider endpoint of a passive or active optical network. It is the terminal equipment for connecting fiber optic trunks.

name: Optical Network Unit
definition: An optical network unit is a kind of optical transmission network connection equipment which is installed at user side.

name: Printer
definition: A machine that has the primary function of printing text and/or graphics onto paper or other media.

name: Radio Block Center
definition: A radio block center is a specialised computing device in railway with specification for generating Movement Authorities (MA) and transmitting it to trains. It gets information from signalling control and from the trains in its section.

name: Repeater
definition: A repeater is an electronic device that receives a signal and retransmits it at a higher level and/or higher power, or onto the other side of an obstruction, so that the signal can cover longer distances without degradation.

name: Router
definition: A router is a networking device whose software and hardware are usually tailored to the tasks of routing and forwarding information. For example, on the Internet, information is directed to various paths by routers.

name: Scanner
definition: A machine that has the primary function of scanning the content of printed matter and converting it to digital format that can be stored in a computer.

name: Telecommand
definition: A system sending command to control and monitor the switches and circuit breakers or systems directly or not connected (e.g. via wires) within the traction power system remotely.

name: Telephony Exchange
definition: A telephony exchange is a device that ensures the routing of telephone calls and communications.

name: Transition Component
definition: A transition component is a minor active device that converts electric signals to optical signals at the sender, and converts optical signals to electric signals at the receiver.

name: Transponder
definition: A transponder is a communication, monitoring, or control device that, upon receiving a signal, emits a different signal in response. Transponders can be either passive or active (e.g., electronic beacon, balise).

name: Transport Equipment
definition: A transport equipment is a network element responsible for providing functionality of transport, multiplexing, switching, management and supervision of transmission channels between different hosts.the bandwidth, the jitter, and the packet loss rate.

name: Compressor
definition: A compressor is a device that compresses a fluid typically used in a refrigeration circuit.

name: Booster
definition: Positive-displacement reciprocating compressor where pressure is increased by a booster.

name: Dynamic
definition: The pressure of refrigerant vapor is increased by a continuous transfer of angular momentum from a rotating member to the vapor followed by conversion of this momentum into static pressure.

name: Hermetic
definition: Positive-displacement reciprocating compressor where the motor and compressor are contained within the same housing, with the motor shaft integral with the compressor crankshaft and the motor in contact with refrigerant.

name: Open Type
definition: Positive-displacement reciprocating compressor where the shaft extends through a seal in the crankcase for an external drive.

name: Reciprocating
definition: Positive-displacement compressor using a piston driven by a connecting rod from a crankshaft.

name: Rolling Piston
definition: Positive-displacement rotary compressor using a roller mounted on the eccentric of a shaft with a single vane in the nonrotating cylindrical housing.

name: Rotary
definition: Positive-displacement compressor using a roller or rotor device.

name: Rotary Vane
definition: Positive-displacement rotary compressor using a roller mounted on the eccentric of a shaft with multiple vanes in the nontotating cylindrical housing.

name: Scroll
definition: Positive-displacement compressor using two inter-fitting, spiral-shaped scroll members.

name: Semihermetic
definition: Positive-displacement reciprocating compressor where the hermetic compressors use bolted construction amenable to field repair.

name: Single Screw
definition: Positive-displacement rotary compressor using a single cylindrical main rotor that works with a pair of gate rotors.

name: Single Stage
definition: Positive-displacement reciprocating compressor where vapor is compressed in a single stage.

name: Trochoidal
definition: Positive-displacement compressor using a rolling motion of one circle outside or inside the circumference of a basic circle and produce either epitrochoids or hypotrochoids.

name: Twin Screw
definition: Positive-displacement rotary compressor using two mating helically grooved rotors, male (lobes) and female (flutes) in a stationary housing with inlet and outlet gas ports.

name: Welded Shell Hermetic
definition: Positive-displacement reciprocating compressor where the motor compressor is mounted inside a steel shell, which, in turn is sealed by welding.

name: Condenser
definition: A condenser is a device that is used to dissipate heat, typically by condensing a substance such as a refrigerant from its gaseous to its liquid state.

name: Air Cooled
definition: A condenser in which heat is transferred to an air-stream.

name: Evaporative Cooled
definition: A condenser that is cooled evaporatively.

name: Water Cooled
definition: [[Water]]-cooled condenser with unspecified operation.

name: Water Cooled Brazedplate
definition: [[Water]]-cooled condenser with plates brazed together to form an assembly of separate channels.

name: Water Cooled Shell Coil
definition: [[Water]]-cooled condenser with cooling water circulated through one or more continuous or assembled coils contained within the shell.

name: Water Cooled Shell Tube
definition: [[Water]]-cooled condenser with cooling water circulated through one or more tubes contained within the shell.

name: Water Cooled Tube In Tube
definition: [[Water]]-cooled condenser consisting of one or more assemblies of two tubes, one within the other.

name: Context
definition: [[IfcContext]] is the generalization of a project context in which objects, type objects, property sets, and properties are defined. The [[IfcProject]] as subtype of [[IfcContext]] provides the context for all information on a construction project, it may include one or several [[IfcProjectLibrary]]'s as subtype of [[IfcContext]] to register the included libraries for the project. A library of products that is referenced is declared within the [[IfcProjectLibrary]] as the context of that library.

name: Control
definition: [[IfcControl]] is the abstract generalization of all concepts that control or constrain the utilization of products, processes, or resources in general. It can be seen as a regulation, cost schedule, request or order, or other requirements applied to a product, process or resource whose requirements and provisions must be fulfilled.

name: Controller
definition: A controller is a device that monitors inputs and controls outputs within a building automation system.

name: Floating
definition: Output increases or decreases at a constant or accelerating rate.

name: Multiposition
definition: Output is discrete value, can be one of three or more values.

name: Programmable
definition: Output is programmable such as Discrete Digital Control (DDC).

name: Proportional
definition: Output is proportional to the control error and optionally time integral and derivative.

name: Twoposition
definition: Output can be either on or off.

name: Conveyor Segment
definition: A conveyor segment defines an occurrence of a flow segment/ continuous run within a conveyor system that joins two sections of the system. these can utilise different carrying methods such as belt, rope, chain, screw etc.

name: Belt Conveyor
definition: An endless belt for carrying material without stretching.

name: Bucket Conveyor
definition: A conveyor in the form of connected buckets or segments that move in a continuous loop

name: Chute Conveyor
definition: Gravity-operated conveyor where media descends through a trough or chute.

name: Screw Conveyor
definition: composed of a longitudinal screw in a trough or pipe that rotates to force media through the segment

name: Cooled Beam
definition: A cooled beam (or chilled beam) is a device typically used to cool air by circulating a fluid such as chilled water through exposed finned tubes above a space. Typically mounted overhead near or within a ceiling, the cooled beam uses convection to cool the space below it by acting as a heat sink for the naturally rising warm air of the space. Once cooled, the air naturally drops back to the floor where the cycle begins again.

name: Active
definition: An active or ventilated cooled beam provides cooling (and heating) but can also function as an air terminal in a ventilation system.

name: Passive
definition: A passive or static cooled beam provides cooling (and heating) to a room or zone.

name: Cooling Tower
definition: A cooling tower is a device which rejects heat to ambient air by circulating a fluid such as water through it to reduce its temperature by partial evaporation.

name: Mechanical Forced Draft
definition: Air flow is produced by a mechanical device, typically one or more fans, located on the inlet air side of the cooling tower.

name: Mechanical Induced Draft
definition: Air flow is produced by a mechanical device, typically one or more fans, located on the air outlet side of the cooling tower.

name: Natural Draft
definition: Air flow is produced naturally.

name: Cost Item
definition: An [[IfcCostItem]] describes a cost or financial value together with descriptive information that describes its context in a form that enables it to be used within a cost schedule. An [[IfcCostItem]] can be used to represent the cost of goods and services, the execution of works by a process, lifecycle cost and more.

name: Cost Schedule
definition: An [[IfcCostSchedule]] brings together instances of [[IfcCostItem]] either for the purpose of identifying purely cost information as in an estimate for constructions costs or for including cost information within another presentation form such as a work order.

name: Budget
definition: An allocation of money for a particular purpose.

name: Cost Plan
definition: An assessment of the amount of money needing to be expended for a defined purpose based on incomplete information about the goods and services required for a construction or installation.

name: Estimate
definition: An assessment of the amount of money needing to be expended for a defined purpose based on actual information about the goods and services required for a construction or installation.

name: Priced Bill of Quantities
definition: A complete listing of all work items forming construction or installation works in which costs have been allocated to work items.

name: Schedule of Rates
definition: A listing of each type of goods forming construction or installation works with the cost of purchase, construction/installation, overheads and profit assigned so that additional items of that type can be costed.

name: Tender
definition: An offer to provide goods and services.

name: Unpriced Bill of Quantities
definition: A complete listing of all work items forming construction or installation works in which costs have not yet been allocated to work items.

name: Course
definition: A built element whose length greatly exceeds its thickness and often also its width, usually of a single material laid on site on top of another horizontal or nearly horizontal built element. A course is distinctive from a earthworks element in that a course is a graded granular (which can be bound or unbound) material that is generally processed in some fashion, where as earthworks elements are soil earthen based structure that can be formed by removal and transport of general ground material.; Structurally a course does not have capacity to carry loads over open span, or to be removed or replaced as a single unit.; * Graded aggregate layers; * Graded sand layers; * Cement bounded material (CBM); * Asphalt layers

name: Armour
definition: An Aggregate layer whose primary function is to protect against erosion of the underlying material by water e.g. riprap.

name: Ballastbed
definition: Layer composed of broken stones under the sleepers.

name: Core
definition: A core course is the bulk internal structure of aggregate structures.

name: Filter
definition: An Intermediate layer whose primary function is to prevent the washing through of fine materials.

name: Pavement
definition: A layer within a pavement structure that forms a paved area or road.

name: Protection
definition: Layer with the primary task to provide protection against erosion and scour.

name: Covering
definition: A covering is an element which covers some part of another element and is fully dependent on that other element. The [[IfcCovering]] defines the occurrence of a covering type, that (if given) is expressed by the IfcCoveringType.

name: Ceiling
definition: The covering is used to represent a ceiling.

name: Cladding
definition: The covering is used to represent a cladding.

name: Coping
definition: A protective capping or covering of a wall or a parapet.

name: Flooring
definition: The covering is used to represent a flooring.

name: Insulation
definition: The covering is used to insulate an element for thermal or acoustic purposes.

name: Membrane
definition: An impervious layer that could be used for e.g. roof covering (below tiling - that may be known as sarking etc.) or as a damp proof course membrane; also, waterproofing material on a bridge structure (typically on top of bridge slab).

name: Molding
definition: The covering is used to represent a molding being a strip of material to cover the transition of surfaces (often between wall cladding and ceiling).

name: Roofing
definition: The covering is used to represent a roof covering.

name: Skirting Board
definition: The covering is used to represent a skirting board being a strip of material to cover the transition between the wall cladding and the flooring.

name: Sleeving
definition: The covering is used to isolate a distribution element from a space in which it is contained.

name: Topping
definition: A layer of material used for leveling or flattening a surface.

name: Wrapping
definition: The covering is used for wrapping particularly of distribution elements using tape.

name: Curtain Wall
definition: A curtain wall is a wall of a building which is an assembly of components, hung from the edge of the floor/roof structure rather than bearing on a floor. Curtain wall is represented as a building element assembly and implemented as a subtype of [[IfcBuiltElement]] that uses an IfcRelAggregates relationship. A curtain wall is often external, but using [[Pset_CurtainWallCommon]].[[IsExternal]] can be used to define interior curtain walls.

name: Damper
definition: A damper typically participates in an HVAC duct distribution system and is used to control or modulate the flow of air.

name: Back Draft Damper
definition: Damper used for purposes of manually balancing pressure differences. Commonly operated by mechanical adjustment.

name: Balancing Damper
definition: Backdraft damper used to restrict the movement of air in one direction. Commonly operated by mechanical spring.

name: Blast Damper
definition: Blast damper used to prevent protect occupants and equipment against overpressures resultant of an explosion. Commonly operated by mechanical spring.

name: Control Damper
definition: Control damper used to modulate the flow of air by adjusting the position of the blades. Commonly operated by an actuator of a building automation system.

name: Fire Damper
definition: Fire damper used to prevent the spread of fire for a specified duration. Commonly operated by fusable link that melts above a certain temperature.

name: Fire Smoke Damper
definition: Combination fire and smoke damper used to prevent the spread of fire and smoke. Commonly operated by a fusable link and a smoke detector.

name: Fumehood Exhaust
definition: Fume hood exhaust damper. Commonly operated by actuator.

name: Gravity Damper
definition: Gravity damper closes from the force of gravity. Commonly operated by gravitational weight.

name: Gravity Relief Damper
definition: Gravity-relief damper used to allow air to move upon a buildup of enough pressure to overcome the gravitational force exerted upon the damper blades. Commonly operated by gravitational weight.

name: Relief Damper
definition: Relief damper used to allow air to move upon a buildup of a specified pressure differential. Commonly operated by mechanical spring.

name: Smoke Damper
definition: Smoke damper used to prevent the spread of smoke. Commonly operated by a smoke detector of a building automation system.

name: Deep Foundation
definition: Deep foundation is a type of foundation that transfers loads deeper than shallow foundation below the soft soils not capable of bearing the above structure. Depending on the soil strength it might have to reach down to the rock layer.

name: Discrete Accessory
definition: A discrete accessory is a representation of different kinds of accessories included in or added to elements.

name: Anchorplate
definition: An accessory consisting of a steel plate, shear stud connectors or welded-on rebar which is embedded into the surface of a concrete element so that other elements can be welded or bolted onto it later.

name: Bird Protection
definition: A device that prevents a sitting down of birds at electrically critical points and thus birds are protected against electrical shocks and disturbances by short circuit are avoided.

name: Bracket
definition: An L-shaped or similarly shaped accessory attached in a corner between elements to hold them together or to carry a secondary element.

name: Cable Arranger
definition: A cable arranger is a flexible accessory or a part of a component placed around cables to arrange and minimize flexing of them at the point where it is placed.

name: Elastic Cushion
definition: A track elastic cushion is a kind of layer set on grooved sides of a concrete base, which is used for mitigating the impact of longitudinal and lateral load on track structures. A track elastic cushion shall only appear in ballastless track structures.

name: Expansion Joint Device
definition: Assembly connection element between construction elements to allow for thermic differential expansions.

name: Filler
definition: Sealant, gap filler rod, packing material or other used to close a gap.

name: Flashing
definition: [[Construction]] material used to manage the passage of water around objects.

name: Insulator
definition: A device designed to support and insulate a conductive element.;definition from IEC 151-15-39.

name: Lock
definition: A lock is a mechanical or electronic fastening device that is released either by a physical object (e.g., key, fingerprint, RFID card, security token etc.), by supplying secret information (e.g., number permutation, password), or by a combination thereof.

name: Panel Strengthening
definition: A component that minimizes pump effects of the substructure.

name: Point Machine Mounting Device
definition: Point machine mounting device.

name: Point Machine Locking Device
definition: Point machine locking device.

name: Rail Brace
definition: A rail component that prevents rails from tipping and twisting.

name: Rail Pad
definition: A non-metallic pad placed between rail and baseplate or rail and sleeper, bearer or slab.;definition from EN 13481-1.

name: Rail Lubrication
definition: A device that prevents wearing of the rails throughout the flange of wheel to reduce noise emissions. It is often located at inner side of the outer rail in a curve or near turnouts (depends on function wearing or noise reduction).

name: Rail Mechanical Equipment
definition: A rail mechanical equipment is a mechnical equipment installed at railside, like blocking device, speed regulator, bias loaded inspector, track scale or controllable retarder.

name: Shoe
definition: A column shoe or a beam shoe (beam hanger) used to support or secure an element.

name: Sliding Chair
definition: A component which supports and retains the stock rail and a flat surface upon which the foot of the switch rail slides.

name: Sound Absorption
definition: A component in the track for sound absorption and may also absorb vibrations. It is often used in combination with slab tracks.

name: Tensioning Equipment
definition: An equipment used to maintain the tension of conductors or cables.

name: Distribution Board
definition: A distribution board is a flow controller in which instances of electrical or communication devices are brought together at a single place for a particular purpose.

name: Consumer Unit
definition: A distribution point on the incoming electrical supply, typically in domestic premises, at which protective devices are located.

name: Dispatching Board
definition: A distribution point at which voice and data communication signals are managed between communication devices.

name: Distribution Board
definition: A distribution point at which connections are made for distribution of electrical circuits usually through protective devices.

name: Distribution Frame
definition: A distribution frame is used to interconnect and manage wiring between active equipment and subscriber. It might be composed of multiple distribution boards and other components.

name: Motor Control Centre
definition: A distribution point at which starting and control devices for major plant items are located.

name: Switch Board
definition: A distribution point at which switching devices are located.

name: Distribution Chamber Element
definition: A distribution chamber element defines a place at which distribution systems and their constituent elements may be inspected or through which they may travel.

name: Formed Duct
definition: Space formed in the ground for the passage of pipes, cables, ducts.

name: Inspection Chamber
definition: Chamber constructed on a drain, sewer or pipeline with a removable cover that permits visible inspection.

name: Inspection Pit
definition: Recess or chamber formed to permit access for inspection of substructure and services.

name: Manhole
definition: Chamber constructed on a drain, sewer or pipeline with a removable cover that permits the entry of a person.

name: Meter Chamber
definition: Chamber that houses a meter(s).

name: Sump
definition: Recessed or small chamber into which liquid is drained to facilitate its collection for removal.

name: Trench
definition: Excavated chamber, the length of which typically exceeds the width.

name: Valve Chamber
definition: Chamber that houses a valve(s).

name: Distribution Circuit
definition: A distribution circuit is a partition of a distribution system that is conditionally switched such as an electrical circuit.

name: Distribution Control Element
definition: The distribution element [[IfcDistributionControlElement]] defines occurrence elements of a building automation control system that are used to impart control over elements of a distribution system.

name: Distribution Element
definition: [[IfcDistributionElement]] is a generalization of all elements that participate in a distribution system.

name: Distribution Flow Element
definition: The distribution element [[IfcDistributionFlowElement]] defines occurrence elements of a distribution system that facilitate the distribution of energy or matter, such as air, water or power.

name: Distribution Port
definition: A distribution port is an inlet or outlet of a product through which a particular substance may flow.

name: Cable
definition: Connection to cable segment or fitting for distribution of electricity.

name: Cable Carrier
definition: Connection to cable carrier segment or fitting for enclosing cables.

name: Duct
definition: Connection to duct segment or fitting for distribution of air.

name: Pipe
definition: Connection to pipe segment or fitting for distribution of solid, liquid, or gas.

name: Wire Less
definition: Wireless connection to communication appliances for distribution of data or communication.

name: Distribution System
definition: A distribution system is a network designed to receive, store, maintain, distribute, or control the flow of a distribution media. A common example is a heating hot water system that consists of a pump, a tank, and an interconnected piping system for distributing hot water to terminals.

name: Air Conditioning
definition: Conditioned air distribution system for purposes of maintaining a temperature range within one or more spaces.

name: Audiovisual
definition: A transport of a single media source, having audio and/or video streams.

name: Catenary System
definition: A longitudinal distribution system that supports contact wires, including catenary wire droppers and stich wires.

name: Chemical
definition: Arbitrary chemical further qualified by property set, such as for medical or industrial use.

name: Chilled Water
definition: Nonpotable chilled water, such as circulated through an evaporator.

name: Communication
definition: Communication

name: Compressed Air
definition: Compressed air system.

name: Condenser Water
definition: Nonpotable water, such as circulated through a condenser.

name: Control
definition: A transport or network dedicated to control system usage.

name: Conveying
definition: Arbitrary supply of substances.

name: Data
definition: A network having general-purpose usage.

name: Disposal
definition: Arbitrary disposal of substances.

name: Domestic Cold Water
definition: Unheated potable water distribution system.

name: Domestic Hot Water
definition: Heated potable water distribution system.

name: Drainage
definition: Drainage collection system.

name: Earthing
definition: A path for equipotential bonding, conducting current to the ground.

name: Electrical
definition: A circuit for delivering electrical power.

name: Electro Acoustic
definition: An amplified audio signal such as for loudspeakers.

name: Exhaust
definition: Exhaust air collection system for removing stale or noxious air from one or more spaces.

name: Fire Protection
definition: Fire protection sprinkler system.

name: Fixed Transmission Network
definition: Represents all wired networks that provide a data transmission channel using optical fiber cables, copper cables or both. It aggregates many technologies that are based on the multiplexing method.

name: Fuel
definition: Arbitrary supply of fuel.

name: Gas
definition: Gas-phase materials such as methane or natural gas.

name: Hazardous
definition: Hazardous material or fluid collection system.

name: Heating
definition: [[Water]] or steam heated from a boiler and circulated through radiators.

name: Light Ing
definition: A circuit dedicated for lighting, such as a fixture having sockets for lamps.

name: Lightning Protection
definition: A path for conducting lightning current to the ground.

name: Mobile Network
definition: Mobile network insures wireless communication by providing a secure platform for voice and data communication between infrastructure operators, including drivers, dispatchers, shunting team members and station controllers.

name: Monitoring System
definition: Sensor-based system for building and infastructure environmental monitoring and control.

name: Municipal Solid Waste
definition: Items consumed and discarded, commonly known as trash or garbage.

name: Oil
definition: Oil distribution system.

name: Operational
definition: Operating supplies system.

name: Operational Telephony System
definition: A system that allows communications between operators (e.g. switchtender, traffic regulator, operational agents, etc.) in operational centers and on the infrastructure site (e.g. railway, tunnel or road).

name: Overhead Contact Line System
definition: An overhead contact line system above the upper limit of the train using an overhead contact line and a catenary system to supply current to traction units.

name: Power Generation
definition: A path for power generation.

name: Rain Water
definition: Rainwater resulting from precipitation which directly falls on a parcel.

name: Refrigeration
definition: Refrigerant distribution system for purposes of fulfilling all or parts of a refrigeration cycle.

name: Return Circuit
definition: A distribution system which forms the intended path for the traction return current and the current under fault conditions.

name: Security
definition: A transport or network dedicated to security system usage.

name: Sewage
definition: Sewage collection system.

name: Signal
definition: A raw analog signal, such as modulated data or measurements from sensors.

name: Storm Water
definition: Stormwater resulting from precipitation which runs off or travels over the ground surface.

name: Telephone
definition: A transport or network dedicated to telephone system usage.

name: TV
definition: A transport of multiple media sources such as analog cable TV, satellite TV, or over-the-air TV.

name: Vacuum
definition: Vacuum distribution system.

name: Vent
definition: Vent system for wastewater piping systems.

name: Ventilation
definition: [[Ventilation]] air distribution system involved in either the exchange of air to the outside as well as circulation of air within a building.

name: Waste Water
definition: [[Water]] adversely affected in quality by anthropogenic influence, possibly originating from sewage, drainage, or other source.

name: Water Supply
definition: Arbitrary water supply.

name: Door
definition: The door is a built element that is predominately used to provide controlled access for people, goods, animals and vehicles. It includes constructions with hinged, pivoted, sliding, and additionally revolving and folding operations.

name: Boom Barrier
definition: A boom barrier (also known as a boom gate) is a bar, or pole pivoted to allow the boom to block vehicular or pedestrian access through a controlled point.

name: Door
definition: A standard door usually within a wall opening, as a door panel in a curtain wall, or as a 'free standing' door.

name: Gate
definition: A gate is a point of entry into a space usually within an opening in a fence. Or as a 'free standing' gate.

name: Trapdoor
definition: A special door that lies horizonally in a slab opening. Often used for accessing cellar or attic.

name: Turnstile
definition: A mechanical gate consisting of revolving arms, allowing only one person at a time to pass through.

name: Duct Fitting
definition: A duct fitting is a junction or transition in a ducted flow distribution system or used to connect duct segments, resulting in changes in flow characteristics to the fluid such as direction and flow rate.

name: Bend
definition: A fitting with typically two ports used to change the direction of flow between connected elements.

name: Connector
definition: Connector fitting, typically used to join two ports together within a flow distribution system (e.g., a coupling used to join two duct segments).

name: Entry
definition: Entry fitting, typically unconnected at one port and connected to a flow distribution system at the other (e.g., an outside air duct system intake opening).

name: Exit
definition: Exit fitting, typically unconnected at one port and connected to a flow distribution system at the other (e.g., an exhaust air discharge opening).

name: Junction
definition: A fitting with typically more than two ports used to redistribute flow among the ports and/or to change the direction of flow between connected elements (e.g, tee, cross, wye, etc.).

name: Obstruction
definition: A fitting with typically two ports used to obstruct or restrict flow between the connected elements (e.g., screen, perforated plate, etc.).

name: Transition
definition: A fitting with typically two ports having different shapes or sizes. Can also be used to change the direction of flow between connected elements.

name: Duct Segment
definition: A duct segment is used to typically join two sections of duct network.

name: Flexible Segment
definition: A flexible segment is a continuous non-linear segment of duct that can be deformed and change the direction of flow.

name: Rigid Segment
definition: A rigid segment is a continuous linear segment of duct that cannot be deformed.

name: Duct Silencer
definition: A duct silencer is a device that is typically installed inside a duct distribution system for the purpose of reducing the noise levels from air movement, fan noise, etc. in the adjacent space or downstream of the duct silencer device.

name: Flat Oval
definition: Flat-oval shaped duct silencer type.

name: Rectangular
definition: Rectangular shaped duct silencer type.

name: Round
definition: Round duct silencer type.

name: Earthworks Cut
definition: The resulting void from modification of existing terrain or road structure by excavation or by other means of removing material.

name: Base Excavation
definition: Excavation for basements of buildings, abutments of bridges or similar structures either partially or completely below ground level.

name: Cut
definition: Excavation where soil or rock below topsoil is cut to the depth required for the construction of facilities such as roads and railways. The removed material can be used as fill ([[IfcEarthworksElement]]) for embankments or to form a level surface on which to build.

name: Dredging
definition: Underwater excavation to recover material or to create a greater depth of water.

name: Excavation
definition: General type of excavation when more accurate type is not specified.

name: Over Excavation
definition: Excavation that goes beyond the depth required for construction, in order to replace unsuitable material.

name: Pavement Milling
definition: Removal of expired material from top of pavement to be replaced by new material.

name: Step Excavation
definition: Removal of the soft part of the existing road slope, where it is dug into steps, when widening a road.

name: Top Soil Removal
definition: Excavation where the topmost layer of soil containing organic material is cut or stripped. The removed topsoil can be used as fill (EarthworksElement) e.g. where planting is planned.

name: Trench
definition: Excavation whose length greatly exceeds the depth and width. Trench is typically excavated for strip foundations or for buried services such as drainage or cabling.

name: Earthworks Element
definition: A type of built element created by earthwork activities to build subgrade, to raise the level of the ground in general or reinforce or stabilize soil by some mechanical or chemical method.

name: Earthworks Fill
definition: A type of earthworks element created by earthwork activities to build subgrade or to raise the level of the ground in general.

name: Backfill
definition: Fill behind retaining walls or other structures such as quays, behind abutments and bridges.

name: Counterweight
definition: Embankment built on the side of the main road structure to reduce the settlement of the road.

name: Embankment
definition: Predominantly longitudinal type of earthworks element with no other particular assigned type according to its role in Pavement or Subgrade.;

name: Slopefill
definition: [[Side]] slope (batter) fill abutting the road structure or back slope fill.

name: Subgrade
definition: [[Type]] of earthworks element forming the structure below pavement and above natural soil.;

name: Subgrade Bed
definition: Upper part of the soil, natural or constructed, that supports the loads transmitted by the overlying structure of a road, runway, or similar hard surface.

name: Transition Section
definition: Section of subgrade to ensure the consistency of stiffness and prevent uneven settlement. Transition section may appear e.g.embankment and bridge abutment; embankment and transverse structure; cutting and tunnel; embankment and cutting.

name: Electric Appliance
definition: An electric appliance is a device intended for consumer usage that is powered by electricity.

name: Dishwasher
definition: An appliance that has the primary function of washing dishes.

name: Electric Cooker
definition: An electrical appliance that has the primary function of cooking food (including oven, hob, grill).

name: Freestanding Electric Heater
definition: An electrical appliance that is used occasionally to provide heat. A freestanding electric heater is a 'plugged' appliance whose load may be removed from an electric circuit.

name: Freestanding Fan
definition: An electrical appliance that is used occasionally to provide ventilation. A freestanding fan is a 'plugged' appliance whose load may be removed from an electric circuit.

name: Freestanding Water Cooler
definition: A small, local electrical appliance for cooling water. A freestanding water cooler is a 'plugged' appliance whose load may be removed from an electric circuit.

name: Freestanding Water Heater
definition: A small, local electrical appliance for heating water. A freestanding water heater is a 'plugged' appliance whose load may be removed from an electric circuit.

name: Freezer
definition: An electrical appliance that has the primary function of storing food at temperatures below the freezing point of water.

name: Fridge Freezer
definition: An electrical appliance that combines the functions of a freezer and a refrigerator through the provision of separate compartments.

name: Hand Dryer
definition: An electrical appliance that has the primary function of drying hands.

name: Kitchen Machine
definition: A specialized appliance used in commercial kitchens such as a mixer.

name: Microwave
definition: An electrical appliance that has the primary function of cooking food using microwaves.

name: Photocopier
definition: A machine that has the primary function of reproduction of printed matter.

name: Refrigerator
definition: An electrical appliance that has the primary function of storing food at low temperature but above the freezing point of water.

name: Tumble Dryer
definition: An electrical appliance that has the primary function of drying clothes.

name: Vending Machine
definition: An appliance that stores and vends goods including food, drink, tickets, and goods of various types.

name: Washing Machine
definition: An appliance that has the primary function of washing clothes.

name: Electric Flow Storage Device
definition: An electric flow storage device is a device in which electrical energy is stored and from which energy may be progressively released.

name: Battery
definition: A device for storing energy in chemical form so that it can be released as electrical energy.

name: Capacitor
definition: A device that stores electric charge when an external power supply is present using the electrical property of capacitance. Two-terminal device characterized essentially by its capacitance.;definition from IEC 60050 151-13-28.

name: Capacitorbank
definition: A device that stores electrical energy when an external power supply is present using the electrical property of capacitance.

name: Compensator
definition: A device that is used to fix or adjust the parameter of electric energy, such as voltage loss, power factor and so on.

name: Harmonic Filter
definition: A device that constantly injects currents that precisely correspond to the harmonic components drawn by the load.

name: Inductor
definition: A device used in circuits or power systems due to their inductance, acting as a component of electric storage device.

name: Inductor Bank
definition: A device that stores electrical energy in a magnetic field using electrical property of inductance.

name: Recharger
definition: A recharger or battery charger is a device used to put energy into a secondary cell or rechargeable battery by forcing an electric current through it.

name: UPS
definition: A device that provides a time limited alternative source of power supply in the event of failure of the main supply.

name: Electric Flow Treatment Device
definition: An electric flow treatment device is used to remove unwanted matter from an electric or electronic signal in a flow distribution system.

name: Electronic Filter
definition: Linear two-port device designed to transmit spectral components of the input quantity according to a specified law, generally in order to pass the components in certain frequency bands and to attenuate those in other bands

name: Electric Generator
definition: An electric generator is an engine that is a machine for converting mechanical energy into electrical energy.

name: CHP
definition: Combined heat and power supply, used not only as a source of electric energy but also as a heating source for the building. It may therefore be not only part of an electrical system but also of a heating system.

name: Engine Generator
definition: Electrical generator with a fuel-driven engine, for example a diesel-driven emergency power supply.

name: Standalone
definition: Electrical generator which does not include its source of kinetic energy, that is, a motor, engine, or turbine are all modeled separately.

name: Electric Motor
definition: An electric motor is an engine that is a machine for converting electrical energy into mechanical energy.

name: DC
definition: A motor using either generated or rectified Direct [[Current]] (DC) power.

name: Induction
definition: An alternating current motor in which the primary winding on one member (usually the stator) is connected to the power source and a secondary winding or a squirrel-cage secondary winding on the other member (usually the rotor) carries the induced current. There is no physical electrical connection to the secondary winding, its current is induced.

name: Polyphase
definition: A two or three-phase induction motor in which the windings, one for each phase, are evenly divided by the same number of electrical degrees.

name: Reluctance Synchronous
definition: A synchronous motor with a special rotor design which directly lines the rotor up with the rotating magnetic field of the stator, allowing for no slip under load.

name: Synchronous
definition: A motor that operates at a constant speed up to full load. The rotor speed is equal to the speed of the rotating magnetic field of the stator; there is no slip.

name: Electric Time Control
definition: An electric time control is a device that applies control to the provision or flow of electrical energy over time.

name: Relay
definition: Electromagnetically operated contactor for making or breaking a control circuit.

name: Time Clock
definition: A control that causes action to occur at set times.

name: Time Delay
definition: A control that causes action to occur following a set duration.

name: Element
definition: An element is a generalization of all components that make up a facility.

name: Element Assembly
definition: The [[IfcElementAssembly]] represents complex element assemblies aggregated from several elements, such as discrete elements, building elements, or other elements.

name: Abutment
definition: A bridge abutment built up of walls, beams, slabs etc.

name: Accessory Assembly
definition: Assembled accessories or components.

name: Arch
definition: A curved structure.

name: Beam Grid
definition: Interconnected beams, located in one (typically horizontal) plane.

name: Braced Frame
definition: A rigid frame with additional bracing members.

name: Cross Bracing
definition: A Structural linear member or assembly of members inside a box girder or between girders, typically on a pier, to resist lateral forces and transfer them to the support.

name: Deck
definition: A platform (such as floor or bridge deck) built up of beams, slabs.

name: Dilatation Panel
definition: Device which permits longitudinal relative rail movement of two adjacent rails, while maintaining correct guidance and support.

name: Entrance Works
definition: An assembly forming the support structure of a chamber (lock, dock) gate and associated elements, plus the containment of operational equipment.

name: Girder
definition: A beam-like superstructure, such as bridge main girder extending between abutments and piers built up of beams, braces (as Members) etc. - may also be an aggregation of girder segments.

name: Grid
definition: A framework of spaced cables or bars that are parallel to or cross each other.

name: Mast
definition: An assembly of plates, members, cables or fasteners that form a vertical structure for the support or mounting of other equipment such as lights, sonar or wireless transmitters.

name: Pier
definition: An intermediate support e.g. in a bridge, built up of walls, columns, beams etc.

name: Pylon
definition: A vertical structure supporting cables in suspended or stayed structure.

name: Rail Mechanical Equipment Assembly
definition: A complex assembly made up of several components like blocking device, speed regulator, bias loaded inspector, track scale or controllable retarder.

name: Reinforcement Unit
definition: Assembled reinforcement elements.

name: Rigid Frame
